versions.changelog:
- Updated metadata in _meta.json with no changes to skill logic or documentation.
- No user-facing changes; functionality and documentation remain the same.

Initial release of the find-skills skill.

- Helps users discover and install agent skills based on their questions or needs.
- Provides guidance on searching for, installing, and presenting relevant skills.
- Includes tips for forming effective queries and troubleshooting when no skills are found.
- Explains common categories of skills and introduces the Skills CLI for managing them.
